strategy.name: 20 EMA Pullback
strategy.description: Trend-following strategy: long entries on pullbacks to the 20 EMA in a confirmed uptrend, short entries in a confirmed downtrend.
strategy.author: Gianni

trend_filter.description: Price must be on the correct side of the EMA to qualify for a trade.
trend_filter.long_condition: close > ema20 AND ema20 is rising (slope > 0 for last 3 bars)
trend_filter.short_condition: close < ema20 AND ema20 is falling (slope < 0 for last 3 bars)

higher_tf_confirmation.rule: Daily EMA20 must align with trade direction

long.step_1: Uptrend confirmed: price above rising EMA20 on primary TF (4h) AND daily TF
long.step_2: Pullback: price retraces to touch or come within 0.5% of EMA20 from above
long.step_3: Bounce candle: a bullish candle closes back above EMA20 after touching it
long.step_4: Volume confirmation: volume on bounce candle >= 80% of 10-bar average volume
long.step_5: RSI check: RSI(14) must be between 40 and 65 at entry (not overbought)

short.step_1: Downtrend confirmed: price below falling EMA20 on primary TF (4h) AND daily TF
short.step_2: Pullback: price retraces to touch or come within 0.5% of EMA20 from below
short.step_3: Rejection candle: a bearish candle closes back below EMA20 after touching it
short.step_4: Volume confirmation: volume on rejection candle >= 80% of 10-bar average volume
short.step_5: RSI check: RSI(14) must be between 35 and 60 at entry (not oversold)

invalidation_rules.long: Do NOT enter if price closes more than 1.5% below EMA20 (breakdown)
invalidation_rules.short: Do NOT enter if price closes more than 1.5% above EMA20 (breakout)
both: Avoid entries within 2h of major news/FOMC/CPI events
Skip if spread between EMA20 and price > 3% (too extended for pullback)
No new entries if daily trend is sideways (EMA20 slope near flat)

stop_loss.long: Unter dem Low der Bounce-Kerze (oder 0.3% unter EMA20, das Weitere)

pre_alert.trigger: Price within 1% of EMA20 in correct trend direction
pre_alert.message: ⚠️ {coin} approaching EMA20 on {tf} — watch for pullback entry

entry_alert.trigger: Bounce/rejection candle confirmed AND all entry conditions met
entry_alert.message: ✅ {coin} EMA20 Pullback Entry — {direction} @ {price} | SL: {sl} | TP1: {tp1} | TP2: {tp2}

invalidation_alert.trigger: Price closes more than 1.5% beyond EMA20 in wrong direction
invalidation_alert.message: ❌ {coin} EMA20 setup INVALID — skip or close early

watchlist_notes.BTC: Lead indicator — check BTC trend before entering alts
watchlist_notes.SOL: Volatile — use wider SL, confirm on 4h before entry
watchlist_notes.LINK: Often leads ETH moves — watch for early signals
watchlist_notes.NEAR: High beta L1 — strong trending phases, good for TP3 trailing
watchlist_notes.AVAX: Strong trends — good for trailing TP3
watchlist_notes.MAGIC: Low-cap gaming token — higher volatility, reduce position size, confirm with 4h volume
watchlist_notes.DOT: Lower volume — confirm with 4h volume filter
watchlist_notes.ADA: Slower mover — better signals on daily TF
